title: NJ road named most haunted in the country for third consecutive year
excerpt: A North Jersey road has become a dynasty in spookiness after being named the most haunted road in the United States for the third consecutive year.
content:
Sept. 25, 2026, 5:32 a.m. ET

  • "Travelers may even encounter the infamous Jersey Devil, making this a truly spine-tingling drive," said rental car agency SIXT.

A North Jersey road has become a dynasty in spookiness after being named the most haunted road in the United States for the third consecutive year.

Clinton Road in West Milford earned its latest honor from the rental car agency SIXT, which also gave the Passaic County street the top spot in 2024 and 2025. Among the rumored sights in the area contributing to the No. 1 ranking is Dead Man's Curve, reportedly home to the ghost of a young boy who tosses back coins thrown into the river.

"Travelers may even encounter the infamous Jersey Devil, making this a truly spine-tingling drive," the site said. "With over 1 million searches for Clinton Road in the past year, its reputation as one of the country’s most mysterious roads continues to draw curious travelers."

SIXT used search trends on Google and TikTok to compile the list of the top 30 most haunted roads in the country. One other New Jersey spot appeared on the ranking: the ominously named Shades of Death Road in Warren County.

Top 10 spookiest roads in America

Below are the 10 spookiest roads in the U.S., according to SIXT:

  1. Clinton Road - New Jersey
  2. Kancamagus Highway - New Hampshire
  3. Route 66 - California
  4. Route 375 Extraterrestrial Highway - Nevada
  5. Bray Road - Wisconsin
  6. Highway 666 - New Mexico
  7. Frontage Road - Montana
  8. Highway 200 - North Dakota
  9. Tower Hill Road - Rhode Island
  10. Interstate 4 - Florida
